auth.label: JY_API_KEY
auth.description: The JY_API_KEY used to access Gildata Data Map MCP financial data services. Request access through the official Data Map product page at https://www.gildata.com/products/datamap.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Gildata Data Map financial MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema with list_tools.

serverType.description: The Gildata Data Map MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Gildata MCP tool.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by Gildata Data Map.

actions.name: compare_stocks
actions.description: Compare two or more stocks across business fundamentals, growth, profitability, cash flow, valuation, industry position, and market performance.

items.description: One stock name or exchange-qualified security code.

securities.description: Stock names or exchange-qualified security codes to compare.

focus.description: Optional aspects that should receive extra attention in the result.

inputSchema.description: The stocks to compare and optional comparison focus.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by Gildata Data Map.

actions.name: get_company_news_and_announcements
actions.description: Find recent company news, exchange announcements, and earnings guidance with source and publication timestamps.

security.description: The company or security name, or an exchange-qualified security code.

startDate.description: The inclusive first publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: The inclusive last publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

focus.description: Optional aspects that should receive extra attention in the result.

inputSchema.description: The company news and announcements request.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by Gildata Data Map.

actions.name: get_macro_data
actions.description: Find macroeconomic or industry indicators for China, local regions, or global economies and return the relevant time-series data.

query.description: The financial question to answer with Gildata Data Map.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by Gildata Data Map.

actions.name: get_stock_overview
actions.description: Get a user-oriented stock overview covering the company, core business, recent market data, financial performance, valuation, peers, and consensus expectations.

security.description: The stock name or exchange-qualified security code, such as 贵州茅台 or 600519.SH.

focus.description: Optional aspects that should receive extra attention in the result.

inputSchema.description: The stock to summarize and optional analysis focus.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The result returned by Gildata Data Map.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Gildata Data Map financial tools and live input schemas from the high-level tool service or the detailed API service.

serverType.description: The Gildata Data Map MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

inputSchema.description: The Gildata MCP service whose tools should be discovered.

serverType.description: The Gildata Data Map MCP service family that owns the requested tool.

name.description: The exact Gildata MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Gildata MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside Gildata.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Gildata Data Map.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Gildata MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by one Gildata Data Map MCP service.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the selected Gildata MCP service.

outputSchema.description: The current tool catalog for one Gildata MCP service.

result.description: The financial data result returned by Gildata. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.
